start.raw_input: Create a tutorial video showing how to use the AI Video Production Manager (VPM) tool. Walk viewers through the complete workflow from entering a video idea to publishing. Demonstrate the 7-stage Advanced mode: Start, Research, Blueprint, Script, Studio, Clips, and Publish. Show how AI assists at every step. Target audience is content creators and marketing teams who want to streamline their video production. About 10 minutes, YouTube format.

research.audience_insights: Primary audience is content creators aged 25–45 who publish 2–8 videos per month. They struggle with the time between idea and finished video. Most use 5+ separate tools. Key pain: context-switching. They search for 'video production workflow' and 'AI video tools'. High willingness to try new tools if onboarding is clear.
research.competitor_analysis: Existing tutorials for Descript, Kapwing, InVideo get 100K–500K views. Most show surface-level UI walkthroughs. Gap: no competitor shows true end-to-end AI-assisted workflow from idea to published video. Opportunity: show VPM’s unique 7-stage pipeline.
research.trending_angles: 'AI video workflow' queries up 280% in 2026. Creators moving from 'AI will replace us' to 'AI as co-pilot'. Behind-the-scenes process videos outperform product demos 3:1. The 'one-click video' narrative is trending but unrealistic — VPM’s guided workflow is more credible.
research.content_strategy: Structure: Hook showing finished video first → 7 sections matching 7 stages → Recap with time comparison. Each section: name the pain, show VPM solving it, highlight AI assist. Screen-style visuals throughout. End with clear CTA.

sections.label: Hook — The Result First
sections.content:
This video you’re watching right now? It was planned, scripted, and produced using AI — and it took less than an hour from idea to export.

In the next 10 minutes, I’m going to show you the exact tool and workflow that made this possible. It’s called the AI Video Production Manager, and it turns a simple text idea into a fully planned, scripted, and production-ready video.
sections.notes: Meta hook — this video was made with the tool.

sections.label: Stage 1: Start
sections.content:
Everything begins in the Start stage. You type your video idea in plain language. Then set your preferences: platform, duration, production style.

Hit “Analyze & Continue” and the AI reads your idea, figures out the best tone, suggests sections, and pre-fills your blueprint. You described a video in one paragraph, and the AI turned it into a production plan.

Choose Standard mode for 5 stages, or Advanced for 7 stages with Research and Studio.
sections.notes: Show Start page, type idea, click Analyze.

sections.label: Stage 2: Research
sections.content:
In Advanced mode, Research is where AI does your homework. Click one button and get four panels: audience insights, competitor analysis, trending angles, and content strategy.

You can edit any panel, regenerate individual sections, and add your own reference sources. Think of it as a research assistant that works in 30 seconds.
sections.notes: Show research panels generating, edit one.

sections.label: Stage 3: Blueprint
sections.content:
The Blueprint is where your video gets structure. Define sections with labels, durations, and key points.

Click “Generate Blueprint” for AI to create a complete structure. When happy, hit “Confirm” — this auto-creates matching script sections.

sections.label: Stage 4: Script
sections.content:
Click “AI Generate” to create a complete script from your blueprint. The AI writes content for every section, matching your tone. Edit directly, or enhance individual sections with AI.

The stats bar shows word count and estimated duration. When satisfied, Finalize to lock the script and save a version.

sections.label: Stage 5: Studio
sections.content:
Studio is where visual identity comes together. Create Looks (characters), Environments (locations), and Scenes (combinations with camera direction).

Click “AI Analyze” to auto-suggest visual elements from your script. Scenes become reusable templates for clip frames.

sections.label: Stage 6: Clips
sections.content:
“Generate from Script” creates a complete clip breakdown. Each clip has a type: AI Visual, Screen Recording, or Template. Three tracks: AI clips get full prompts, Non-AI get briefs, Templates auto-apply.

For AI clips, generate frame prompts and video prompts. The split layout shows your list and detail panel side by side.
sections.notes: Show generation, split layout, prompt tabs.

sections.label: Stage 7: Publish
sections.content:
“Generate Metadata” creates YouTube titles, descriptions, tags, and chapters from your content. The Thumbnail Workshop generates 4 concepts you can refine through AI chat.

VPM also generates captions for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Export your script, shot list, and prompt library as files.

sections.label: Recap
sections.content:
Traditional workflow: 8 hours minimum. With VPM: 45 minutes. Not replacing you — amplifying you. Every stage has AI, but you control every step.

Try VPM — link in description. Subscribe for more AI content creation tutorials.
